name: checkpoint-switch2
title: Checkpoint
author: Bernardo Giordano, FlagBrew; Switch 2 port by wowilookgood
description: An unofficial Switch 2 build of Checkpoint, the save manager.
details:
Checkpoint backs up and restores save data. This is an unofficial build of Checkpoint 5.3.0 for a Switch 2 running kaiHEN, not an upstream release. It draws with OpenGL ES 3.

Its working folder is /switch/Checkpoint. The built-in updater is off: it would install the Switch 1 build.

Report Switch 2 problems in the fork's issues, not to upstream.
changelog: 5.3.0.1 (release v5.3.0-switch2-1): first Switch 2 build, from Checkpoint 5.3.0.
